analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation edit to docs/developer/test.md (head lines ~2057-2058). It extends the CI job-shape test description to cover a `required` lane that keeps its fallback without asking while DARKBLOOM_JOB_SHAPES is off. No source code, wire protocol, attestation, key handling, cache storage or authorization behavior changes. The supplied units are base-text excerpts (lines 928-1806) of the test guide, and the changed lines (2057-2058) fall outside the supplied excerpt. I could only verify the change through the patch hunk, not the surrounding lines. The excerpted prose is test documentation covering provider endpoint resumption and logout, add-on hold (TB-012/T-059/T-060), App Attest dispatch, native qualification, cache and SSD tier tests, and fixture downloaders. It makes no new claim that conflicts with the threat model, and it repeats the model's own caveats that these tests do not establish physical Apple qualification or end-to-end authorization. The CI runner-routing change described, a `required` lane keeping its fallback, is a CI infrastructure matter with no visible link to the threat-model assets. The implementation of the described runner behavior (scripts and workflows) is not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot assess it. I identified no security regression and no need for a threat-model update.
